summary.text: Bill Hauter is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 87th District, serving since January 2023, according to the Illinois General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: His legislature biography describes a physician from Morton who graduated from the University of Illinois College of Medicine in 1997 and practices emergency medicine and anesthesiology at OSF Saint Francis Medical Center in Peoria.
It says he was elected to the Tazewell County Board and was appointed to Illinois' Rare Disease Commission in July 2023.
